name: steam-workshop-archiver
description: Self-hosted Steam Workshop archiver: list a game's Workshop (or a collection / item list), download it with SteamCMD or DepotDownloader, keep it updated on a schedule, and browse it offline.

paths.name: Metadata
paths.description: Database, metadata, cached images and SteamCMD. Put it on a cache/SSD pool.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID files are written as

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID files are written as

variables.name: Auth password
variables.description: Optional HTTP Basic auth password for the whole UI and API (any username)

variables.name: Steam Web API key
variables.description: Optional. Lists items via the official API (beyond the 30,000-item browse limit). Can also be set in Settings.

variables.name: Allowed hosts
variables.description: Host header allowlist (DNS-rebinding protection). auto = IPs, localhost and LAN names; add your reverse-proxy domain, e.g. auto,archive.example.com
